name: minio
title: MinIO
author: yunix-intel
description:
龙芯版说明

架构：linux/loong64（仅龙芯 3A5000/3A6000）

与上游差异：Go 源码编；单目录模式无纠删码。

缺失功能：无纠删码/多盘冗余；无内置 TLS。

额外依赖：必须设 MINIO_ROOT_USER/PASSWORD；AGPLv3；9000/9001。

镜像说明：RELEASE.2025-10-15T17-29-55Z；Go 1.27 源码编；`/data`；9000/9001；UID 1000；必须设 MINIO_ROOT_USER/PASSWORD；AGPLv3；单盘无纠删码
description_en:
LoongArch notes

Architecture: linux/loong64 only

Differences: Built from Go source; single-directory mode has no erasure coding.

Missing features: No erasure coding or multi-disk redundancy; no built-in TLS.

Extra dependencies: MINIO_ROOT_USER/PASSWORD are required; AGPLv3; ports 9000/9001.

Image notes: RELEASE.2025-10-15T17-29-55Z；Go 1.27 源码编；`/data`；9000/9001；UID 1000；必须设 MINIO_ROOT_USER/PASSWORD；AGPLv3；单盘无纠删码

notes: 必须设置根凭据；9000 API，9001 控制台；/data 持久化。
未在 OpenWrt/iStoreOS 真机上执行安装回归；仅做 ipk 结构与 JSON schema 静态校验。
